text:
maya: opening a docs PR to add a preflight e2e test script for onprem installs (zero-trust mTLS + HSM connectivity). need reviewers: @jonathan @samira

jonathan: nice. can we also include a minimal systemd unit to auto-mount the offline bundle on boot? would cut down support loops.

maya: yep adding snippet in the PR. draft command:
```bash
# run on bootstrap node
sudo /opt/redwood/install/preflight-check --bundle-path /tmp/offline-bundle.tar.gz --verify
```

samira: tiny nit — CLI changed in 0.9.2: `--bundle-path` is correct. also we should surface a `--skip-hsm` flag for local dev.

maya: ack, adding `--skip-hsm` and a note. also plan to include a quick mTLS KMS validation example for customers to run after bootstrap:
```bash
curl --cert client.pem --key client.key --cacert ca.pem https://kms.local/v1/health
```

jonathan: can we include the expected 200 JSON body so CI can assert it? and an env var example for our test harness, eg `REDWOOD_KMS_HOST=kms.local`

maya: will add expected body + CI env example. also found two 404s when linking to the HSM role mapping page and the systemd tips doc — fixing those links in the PR.

deploy-bot: CI started for PR #8423 — docs lint, linkcheck

docs-ci: linkcheck failed: docs/private/hsm-role-mapping.md -> 404

samira: that's the doc I'm simultaneously migrating. pushing a redirect and a short migration note: "if you used pkcs11 v1, update role mapping YAML key to `hsmRoles`"

maya: ping when redirect is up — I reference it from the preflight section.

samira: redirect pushed in PR #8430, added migration snippet + example YAML and a test checklist entry for HSM plugin loading.

maya: updated docs PR with redirect target and CLI flag updates. PTAL @jonathan

jonathan: quick nit: call out systemd compatibility — add a line "systemd unit works on systemd >= 244" so older distros aren't surprised. otherwise LGTM.

maya: added the compatibility clause and a short troubleshooting block for pkcs11 failures (common errno map). ready to merge after green CI :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: CI passed for PR #8423 — docs lint OK, linkcheck OK

samira: thanks everyone. I'll land the redirect first then follow up with a support KB linking to the new preflight script.

maya: shipping. closing thread.
